Title: Azure Monitor for AKS-Engine will not be supported on 14 September 2026

Body.Content:
On 14 September 2026, AKS-Engine will be retired. With this retirement, Azure Monitor users will no longer have access to the UX support, portal experience, or monitoring agent for any applications hosted on AKS-Engine.  

Required action 

To avoid monitoring disruption, please enable Azure Monitor when you migrate to AKS before 14 September 2026. 

Help and support   

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, Please see our support policy.    

If you have additional questions, please contact us at ibraraslam@microsoft.com
